facts.text: Kid, you can make the sandwiches tonight. Just keep out of my way and don't touch my drink.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Willie never says this. The Willie lines on the Moviemistakes page I opened (a short list) are about being an eating, drinking Santa and a bathroom exchange with a kid, nothing about sandwiches.
facts.fix: Kid, you can make the sandwiches tonight. Just keep out of my way and don't touch my drink.

fix_note.text: Kid, you can make the sandwiches tonight. Just keep out of my way and don't touch my drink.

facts.text: Willie skipped dinner and ate the advent calendar.
facts.why: The kid offers Willie the advent calendar chocolate and Willie says "You go ahead"; Willie never eats it. He does tell the kid to make sandwiches for dinner.
facts.fix: Willie told the kid to make sandwiches for dinner.

vibe.verdict: A dark bar tab menu that suits the film's mood, with the sandwiches and the Phoenix mall, but the signed line is invented and one nachos note is unproven.
